# Diagram standards

## Authority

- Follow the diagrams standard for shape and content rules for .canon/diagrams/<kind>.md files. It is the single source. Read it with `canon standards diagrams`.
- Layout, budgets, accessibility, labels, and render verification inside the fence are a separate topic. The mermaid standard routes them.
